why: A test that imports the schema is the strongest proof there is that someone reads it: if the schema changes, the test breaks. The rule looked for the reader only in PRODUCTION code, because `fontes()` drops tests — and tests are what almost every other rule really should ignore. Measured on 2026-08-30: `openkartline` was accused of two schemas "defined and never read" with `apps/web/src/services/schemaContract.test.ts` importing both on lines 2 and 3. It was the only accusation of this rule across the 11 repositories, and it was false. Both sides have the SAME schema and the SAME test; on the `fail` side the test validates something else, so the schema is left with no reader at all.
